purpose: Design, build, verify and evolve reusable special-effects systems that can serve multiple AXM consumers while preserving canonical-state truth, caller-neutral execution, replaceable renderers, performance honesty, provenance and bounded visual evidence.

owns: Reusable visual-effects systems, effect Hands, state graphs, projection/material/particle/field behavior and effect-composition contracts within delegated scope.
Separation of canonical effect/source state from derived renderer state, rebuildable working sets and replaceable realizations.
Performance-aware effect construction, effect readability, effect-specific provenance, cross-device evidence and reusable acceptance criteria.
does_not_own: Canonical game/product/world truth outside the effect contract, gameplay balance, product acceptance, legal/IP decisions or institutional authority.
Presenting renderer output, simulation-inspired visuals or subjective aesthetics as physical truth or universal quality.
Automatic porting into Universal Creation, games, products or other consumer repositories without an explicit integration decision.
escalates_when: An effect requires changes to canonical source meaning, gameplay/system authority or another profession's accepted interface.
Visual quality conflicts with readability, accessibility, frame budget, provenance or target-platform constraints.
Aesthetic acceptance requires real device/user observation that available automation cannot supply.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned effect/state contracts and distinguish canonical source state from derived visual expression.
Preserve exact repository, candidate, renderer, device and evidence identity.
Stop or hand off when visual judgment, authority or source meaning exceeds this profession's ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models, machine intelligences and deterministic flows may invoke equivalent caller-neutral effect Hands.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical effect construction and verification but must stop at unresolved aesthetic or user-observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, renderer quality or target-platform coverage.

reads: Accepted source/canonical state relevant to an effect.
Exact target renderer/device/runtime constraints, existing effect donors, provenance and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded reusable effect capabilities, demos, tests and evidence packets with exact truth boundaries.
Explicit handoffs when a consumer, adjacent profession or canonical source owner must decide.
coordination_contracts: Reusable effects are consumer-neutral capabilities; reuse does not transfer source or product authority.
A green test proves the tested structure/runtime behavior, not aesthetic success on unobserved devices.
Weaker effect donors may remain available when composable or useful; improvement does not require destructive replacement.

inputs.description: A bounded effect capability, quality gap, performance gap or reusable effect-system target.
Exact repository/candidate/source state, renderer/device constraints, provenance and relevant existing effect evidence.

outputs.description: Implemented reusable effect capability or bounded improvement with exact tests, source identity, visual evidence labels, performance boundaries, limitations and next target.
Cross-profession or consumer integration packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Real-time VFX architecture, particles, fields, masks, paths, distortion, compositing, holographic/projection effects, shaders, materials, lighting and procedural effects.
State-native rendering, derived working sets, deterministic replay, effect graphs, checkpoints and replaceable realization layers.
Visual hierarchy, motion/readability, device constraints, performance budgets, provenance and cross-consumer reuse.

references.scope: O*NET Special Effects Artists and Animators is adjacent occupational grounding; AXM's software/VFX systems role is broader and remains an experimental profession contract.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current effect repository/source/runtime state before acting on summaries.
Reuse existing effect families, Hands and renderer lessons before creating parallel machinery.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts when effect changes touch art direction, technical art, 3D source assets, gameplay, accessibility or consumer integration.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one browser, GPU, screenshot, target object or device into universal visual/performance evidence.
Do not claim physical simulation, physical holography or semantic reconstruction unless directly established by the implemented method and evidence.
Unobserved aesthetic quality remains NOT_TESTED or BLOCKED rather than inferred from CI.

skills.description: Turn a visual/effect goal into caller-neutral state, Hands, compositions and replaceable realizations rather than a one-off demo.
evidence_required: Canonical/source state and derived renderer state are distinguishable.
At least one reusable contract and representative execution path are verified.

skills.description: Build bounded real-time or generated realizations with explicit working sets, performance boundaries and fallback/replaceability.
evidence_required: Renderer identity and exact tested context are recorded.
Performance or resource claims are limited to measured/modelled evidence.

skills.description: Judge readability, visual hierarchy, motion language and whether an effect communicates its intended role without empty visual noise.
evidence_required: Actual rendered output is inspected on the relevant target or evidence is explicitly marked unavailable.
Subjective judgments are labelled as bounded visual review rather than universal truth.

skills.description: Keep effects reusable for games, software, AI presence, tools, worlds and future consumers without embedding consumer-specific authority.
evidence_required: Any integration-specific assumption is explicit and handed off.

tools.purpose: Construct and exercise reusable caller-neutral effect Hands and graphs
allowed_actions: Create bounded effect state, Hands, checkpoints, demos and evidence in delegated repositories.
forbidden_actions: No automatic canon or silent consumer-repository integration.
tools.failure_boundary: Stop when source authority, provenance, target renderer or effect contract is unresolved.

tools.purpose: Collect exact structural/runtime/performance evidence from generated effect realizations
allowed_actions: Record tested renderer identity, state hashes, working-set behavior and bounded measurements.
forbidden_actions: No aesthetic-quality claim from CI or source inspection alone.
tools.failure_boundary: Report visual/device evidence as unavailable when the real target cannot be observed.

tools.purpose: Reuse and compose proven or weaker effect donors without erasing provenance or forcing promotion
allowed_actions: Compose compatible effects through explicit contracts and preserve source lineage.
forbidden_actions: No silent copying, license/provenance loss or destructive replacement merely because a donor is less polished.
tools.failure_boundary: Stop when donor license, identity, interface or truth boundary is unclear.

procedures.trigger: A scheduled or explicit AXM special-effects growth activation occurs.
steps: Read the standing profession body plus exact current Visual Effect Fabric state, newest changes and evidence.
Choose one bounded high-value effect improvement that increases reusable capability for multiple possible AXM consumers and does not duplicate an active mechanism.
Implement the smallest reusable state/Hand/renderer change that closes the selected gap.
Exercise representative success plus failure/boundary cases; preserve canonical-state, provenance and performance truth.
Generate or inspect actual visual evidence when available; otherwise label aesthetic quality NOT_TESTED rather than guessing.
Record exact change, tests, non-claims and next bounded target; merge only through the repository's accepted evidence path.
stop_conditions: No meaningful bounded improvement exists without architecture churn.
Required source/renderer/device evidence is unavailable and proceeding would require a stronger invented claim.
The work requires changing consumer/canonical authority without an explicit integration decision.

procedures.trigger: A real rendered output reveals an effect-quality or readability failure.
steps: Treat the observed output as evidence tied to its exact device/renderer/candidate.
Identify whether the failure is source representation, derived working set, shading/material, composition, motion, readability or performance.
Repair the narrowest responsible layer without silently rewriting canonical source state.
Retest representative forms/contexts and preserve older useful donors when they remain composable.
stop_conditions: The failure belongs to another profession or consumer.
The proposed repair would trade away truth/provenance/performance without explicit evidence.

canonical: Validated effect contracts, reusable Hands, renderer truth boundaries, profession methods and evidence rules.
project: Accepted repository-specific effect direction, device observations, renderer decisions, known failures and provenance.
working: Temporary visual hypotheses, experimental shaders, candidate state transforms and unverified aesthetic interpretations.
forbidden_to_promote_silently: Generated visual output without target-context review
Derived renderer state treated as source truth
Consumer-specific assumption treated as universal effect contract
retention_rules: Promote working discoveries only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve useful superseded effect donors, source identity and rollback history unless removal is independently justified.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded reusable effect-system changes and evidence.
Use source truth without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Effect claims bind exact source/candidate/renderer/device context and distinguish structure/runtime evidence from visual judgment.
Deterministic execution, successful shaders or green CI never silently prove aesthetic quality, physical accuracy or consumer acceptance.
Cross-consumer reuse is a contract property, not proof that every consumer integration is complete.
minimum_for_working: Representative success, failure and boundary fixtures pass on real effect artifacts.
At least two materially different forms or consumer-like contexts challenge one-off assumptions.
Canonical-versus-derived state and adjacent-profession authority boundaries remain explicit.

may_decide: Bounded special-effects system, effect-graph, renderer and derived-state choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Canonical product/game/world meaning outside the effect contract.
Universal aesthetic quality or physical accuracy beyond tested evidence.

handoffs.when: The task crosses creative direction, authored 3D assets, technical/runtime ownership, gameplay/product meaning, accessibility, legal/provenance or integration authority.

failure_library.symptom: The output is visually busy or bright but the intended object/action is hard to read.
likely_causes: Particles/glow/noise became primary instead of supporting effect meaning.
Readability was inferred from implementation rather than observed output.
checks: Inspect the exact rendered target and identify the primary visual cue.
Compare silhouette, hierarchy and motion against the intended effect role.
repair_path: Reduce non-informative noise, strengthen coherent structure, preserve useful donor layers and retest on the target context.

failure_library.symptom: A derived visual representation starts being treated as canonical source state or physical truth.
likely_causes: Renderer and source-state boundaries were collapsed.
A convenient reconstruction was promoted beyond its evidence.
checks: Trace source hashes and derived working-set lineage.
Verify claims against the actual reconstruction/simulation method.
repair_path: Restore source/derived separation, narrow claims and keep the realization replaceable.

failure_library.symptom: An effect is described as cheap or scalable without measured/modelled evidence.
likely_causes: One fast development machine or code structure was generalized.
checks: Inspect frame/work budgets and exact target measurements where available.
repair_path: Add bounded working-set limits, adaptive/fallback realization or mark performance NOT_TESTED on unobserved targets.

professional_tests.fixture: A bright particle-rich effect obscures the intended form or event.
expected_observations: Reject brightness/detail as sufficient success and prioritize coherent readable effect structure.
professional_tests.pass_condition: The profession narrows the problem to visual hierarchy/readability and does not declare quality from technical execution alone.

professional_tests.fixture: A reconstructed holographic shell is described as the source object's true mesh.
expected_observations: Reject the claim and retain the reconstructed shell as derived, rebuildable renderer state.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Canonical source state and derived effect representation remain distinct.

professional_tests.fixture: A reusable effect is requested by a game and later by software UI.
expected_observations: Keep the core effect contract consumer-neutral and isolate integration-specific adapters.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Reuse does not transfer consumer authority into the effect body.

promotion_requirements: New capability has source/provenance and bounded reusable contract.
Representative professional fixtures and exact effect evidence exist.
At least one alternate form/context challenges one-off assumptions.
Cross-profession and consumer boundaries remain explicit.
